// CASE dart_awaited_callee_receiver expect=fire
Future<List<R?>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<Client<T, R>> Function() pool) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await (await pool()).send(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_awaited_callee_index expect=fire
Future<List<R?>> mapWithConcurrency2<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, List<Client<T, R>> clients) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await clients[await pickSlot()].send(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_then_chain expect=fire
Future<List<R?>> mapWithConcurrency3<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index]).then((value) async {
        await audit(value);
        return value;
      });
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_iife_callee expect=fire
Future<List<R?>> mapWithConcurrency4<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await ((T item) async { await audit(item); return operation(item); })(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}
